rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase (3% for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026)
rules.requirement: If your unit is covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, your landlord may raise the rent only once a year, by no more than the allowed percentage. That was 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. RSO and SCEP surcharges ($1.61 and $2.83 a month) may be added on top only after the landlord registers the unit and gives you written notice.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance. Tenants can check coverage at zimas.lacity.org. This page does not state the coverage criteria.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. Ch. XV, Art. 1)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
rules.conflict_note: The page was retrieved on 2026-10-01 but still shows the 3% figure for July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026, a period that has ended. It gives no allowable percentage for July 2026 – June 2027, so the current figure needs to be checked. The page also does not state the RSO coverage tests (generally 2+ units with a certificate of occupancy on or before Oct 1, 1978), so the coverage fields are left blank.

rules.title: RSO: no extra utility percentage added to the annual increase
rules.requirement: Starting February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units may not add any extra percentage for utilities on top of the annual allowable rent increase.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. Ch. XV, Art. 1)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

notes: The page does not cite any ordinance section. The citation given is the general RSO chapter of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (L.A.M.C.); the specific section (likely L.A.M.C. § 151.06) is not confirmed by this document. The 3% figure covers a period that ended June 30, 2026, before the 2026-10-01 status date, and the page gives no figure for 2026-27. The SCEP ($2.83 a month, effective 2022-01-01) and RSO ($1.61 a month, effective 2020-01-01) surcharge pass-throughs are folded into the first record, not given separate records. The page says state law requires 30 days' written notice for rent increases under 10%. That was not extracted because it is a notice procedure rule and the page gives no statute. Coverage criteria for RSO units are not given in this document.
